title: A/P Detail: the Vendor menu ticks several vendors and the chip counts them
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Vendors {Vendor-A} and {Vendor-B} have open bills on today's date; {Vendor-B}'s name is longer than the chip can show.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-29 Short and {Vendor-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-29 Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment and Trailer Repair.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/P Detail is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the Vendor chip and read the menu from top to bottom.
  2. Type part of {Vendor-B}'s name in the search box and tick {Vendor-B}.
  3. Read the chip.
  4. Search for {Vendor-A} and tick it.
  5. Read the chip and expand every group.
  6. Untick both vendors.
  7. Read the chip.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens with a search box whose placeholder reads "Search vendors", an "All vendors" row, the line "All vendors are included. Pick one or more to narrow." and the list of vendors.
  • Step 2: {Vendor-B} is ticked.
  • Step 3: the chip shows {Vendor-B}'s name, shortened with "..." because it is long.
  • Step 4: {Vendor-A} is ticked as well.
  • Step 5: the chip reads "Vendor: 2 vendors"; only the two vendors' rows remain.
  • Step 6: no vendor is ticked.
  • Step 7: "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style.

Whether the one-name chip also says "Vendor: " is question 10; from what length a name is shortened is question 11.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”
